metadata.title: Secure Survey

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for conducting surveys and feedback collection in a manner that is trustworthy, privacy-respecting, ethically governed, and institutionally defensible.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Survey platforms, feedback systems, response storage, anonymization controls, data protection mechanisms, and ethics oversight processes.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Composite pattern asserting that all trust requirements for secure, ethical survey operations are satisfied.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Secure surveys assume baseline authority, purpose clarity, and response integrity.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Secure surveys require defensible handling of respondent identity and anonymity guarantees.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Secure surveys require protection of collected responses against misuse, disclosure, and inappropriate secondary use.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Secure surveys require informed consent, voluntariness, withdrawal rights, and ethical oversight.

props.name: attack-tactic
props.remarks: Social engineering through deceptive or misleading survey solicitation.

props.name: attack-tactic
props.remarks: Collection and misuse of sensitive information obtained through surveys.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Improper collection of personal or identifying information via surveys.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Inference or exposure of individual responses from survey datasets.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Policy enforcement to constrain permissible survey purposes and handling.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Lifecycle management to enforce response withdrawal, aggregation, and suppression rules.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Audit logging and traceability to support accountability and ethical oversight.

metadata.remarks: Secure Survey is a composite pattern asserting that surveys are conducted as intentional, ethical, and defensible communication mechanisms. It introduces no independent controls and exists solely as an aggregate trust claim for solution patterns, risk analysis, and system security and privacy plans.

components.title: Survey Core
components.description: Baseline trust assumptions for survey solicitation and response collection.

components.title: Survey Identity and Anonymity
components.description: Defensible handling of respondent identity, anonymity, and re-identification risk.

components.title: Survey Data Protection
components.description: Protection of collected responses against misuse, disclosure, and unsafe reuse.

components.title: Survey Consent and Ethics
components.description: Informed consent, voluntariness, withdrawal, and ethical oversight.
